blocks.title: One Call Per Field Per Parent
blocks.text: A GraphQL response is a tree built by one function call per field per parent. Every performance and correctness question is: how many calls run, and what does each one touch?

caption.text: Part 2 of GRAPHQL INTERNALS. Your resolver returned an object and the next resolver got it — that one sentence is the entire GraphQL execution model, and almost every bug you will ship is a corollary of it. Ten pages on the four arguments, the default resolver that quietly runs most of your schema, why root mutations are the spec's only ordering guarantee, and how one non-null field can null your whole response. Save it for the next time a field comes back null and nobody knows why.
